name: Complete Evidence Appraisal Tool
description: A high-performance, crash-proof research synthesis platform for methodological appraisal (AMSTAR 2, CASP, AGREE II, GRADE, RoB 2, CFIR, KTA, PRISMA 2020), document inspection (PDF, JATS/XML, DOCX, RIS), dual-reviewer consensus, Cohen's kappa, and SHA-256 evidence traceability.
